propositions: The project.portability criterion's Platform and venue matrix cell currently uses a single undifferentiated 'CI' label, making it impossible to name specific CI providers or projects with no CI at all as alternate venues for portability testing.

A plan that schedules automatic work only through a specific CI system (e.g., GitHub Actions schedule) with no operation-linked or in-process fallback breaks for projects using different CI providers or no CI at all.

The criterion's detection rubric must extend its matrix cell to enumerate 'CI under any provider (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and others), projects with NO CI provider at all' and add an explicit rule naming sole CI-system triggers as a portability finding.

Documentation mirrors in docs/plan-review-gate.md and test pinning in test_project_portability_criterion.py and test_project_portability_docs.py must be updated to reflect the expanded matrix and rule so detection efficacy is verified and mirrors remain in sync with the authoritative rubric.
